name: Io
pages: Io is found near Jupiter. Look for the ugly green structure.$(br2)Natural resources: sulfur, lapis lazuli, iron, ionian dust (lime lunar dust).$(br)Mobs: Astral/Voided/Cyborg Piglins, Sulfur Cubes, Voided, Skeletons, SpaceFellows, Lunar Slimes

pages.text: Ionian bricks can be used to craft a portal to Io, and then lit using flint & steel.$(br)This does mean you need to visit Io for the first time using the spaceship, or be in creative mode!$(br2)Note: portals can only be used to or from the overworld!
Check out some fun facts about Io, courtesy of NASA!
